recipe:
let garment_waist: length = waist_girth + ease_waist
let garment_hip: length = hip_girth + ease_hip
let quarter_waist: length = garment_waist / 4
let quarter_hip: length = garment_hip / 4
let suppression: length = quarter_hip - quarter_waist
let dart_intake: length = suppression - ss_suppress
let side_seam_total: length = 4 * ss_suppress
let dart_total: length = 4 * dart_intake
let front_dart_centre: length = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) / 2
let back_dart_centre: length = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) / 2
let quarter_hem_width: length = quarter_hip + a_line_flare
let garment_hem: length = 4 * quarter_hem_width
let hip_to_hem_drop: length = waist_to_hem - waist_to_hip
let side_seam_length: length = hypot(hip_to_hem_drop, a_line_flare)
let waistband_pattern_length: length = garment_waist + 2 * sa_cb + wb_extension
let waistband_cut_width: length = 2 * wb_width + sa_waist + sa_wb_bottom
let waistband_fold_position: length = waistband_cut_width / 2
let waistband_finished_length: length = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb
let wb_interfacing_width: length = wb_width
let wb_interfacing_length: length = waistband_finished_length
let waistband_length_closure: length = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb - wb_extension
let waistband_width_closure: length = waistband_cut_width - sa_waist - sa_wb_bottom
assert allocation_balance: eps_num = 4 * (ss_suppress + dart_intake) == garment_hip - garment_waist
assert waist_closure: eps_num = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) - dart_intake == quarter_waist
assert waistband_length_closure: eps_num = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb - wb_extension == garment_waist
assert waistband_width_closure: eps_num = waistband_cut_width - sa_waist - sa_wb_bottom == 2 * wb_width
let waist_side_x: length = quarter_hip - ss_suppress
let front_dart_out_x: length = front_dart_centre + dart_intake / 2
let front_dart_in_x: length = front_dart_centre - dart_intake / 2
let back_dart_out_x: length = back_dart_centre + dart_intake / 2
let back_dart_in_x: length = back_dart_centre - dart_intake / 2
let curve_hip_y: length = waist_to_hip / 2
let curve_waist_y: length = waist_to_hip / 6
let curve_waist_x: length = waist_side_x + ss_suppress / 3
let grain_x: length = quarter_hip / 2
let side_cut_x: length = quarter_hip + sa_side
let label_x: length = quarter_hip / 4
let label_y: length = waist_to_hip * 3 / 2
let wb_x0: length = sa_cb
let wb_x1: length = sa_cb + waistband_finished_length
let wb_y0: length = sa_waist
let wb_y1: length = sa_waist + 2 * wb_width
let wb_cb_left_x: length = sa_cb + wb_extension
let wb_q1_x: length = wb_cb_left_x + quarter_waist
let wb_q2_x: length = wb_cb_left_x + 2 * quarter_waist
let wb_q3_x: length = wb_cb_left_x + 3 * quarter_waist
let wb_grain_y: length = waistband_fold_position / 2
let wb_label_x: length = waistband_pattern_length / 4
let wb_label_y: length = waistband_fold_position + wb_width / 2
let if_label_x: length = wb_interfacing_length / 4
let if_label_y: length = wb_interfacing_width / 2

labels.text: skirt_front | size M | cut 1 | place on fold | fabric: shell | colorway: not specified
skirt_back_right | size M | cut 1 | R, pair with skirt_back_left | fabric: shell | colorway: not specified
skirt_back_left | size M | cut 1 | L, mirror of skirt_back_right | fabric: shell | colorway: not specified
waistband | size M | cut 1 | fold lengthwise at internal line | fabric: shell | colorway: not specified | hook-and-bar extension: first 3 cm beyond left CB notch
waistband_interfacing | size M | cut 1 | fabric: interfacing | colorway: not specified | fuse to wrong side of lower half, no allowance
